amenityHighlights: North Star pod rising 300 ft above sea

cabinCategories.description: Royal Caribbean's stylish interior stateroom on Anthem — virtual windows in many interior cabins stream live ocean views.
Bright oceanview stateroom with large window. Watch Alaska glide past from the comfort of your room.
Private balcony stateroom — perfect for spotting wildlife and watching the Inside Passage scenery from your own outdoor perch.
Royal Suite with panoramic views, baby grand piano, private balcony, and exclusive suite lounge and sundeck access.

entertainmentOptions: We Will Rock You (Queen tribute show)
inclusions: Main dining room and Windjammer Market buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Anthem of the Seas — one of Royal Caribbean's most innovative ships — departs on a 7-night Alaska adventure.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A full day of scenic cruising through the breathtaking Inside Passage. Watch for humpback whales, orcas, Steller sea lions, and bald eagles from the Two70 observation lounge.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital — take a whale watching cruise, hike to Mendenhall Glacier, or ride the Mount Roberts Tramway for panoramic views of the Lynn Canal.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Experience the drama of the Klondike Gold Rush era. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway is one of North America's most spectacular train journeys.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Totem poles, Creek Street, and world-class salmon fishing define this vibrant Alaska port. A floatplane tour to Misty Fjords is unforgettable.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An elegant evening in Canada's most European city. Visit the iconic Empress Hotel for traditional high tea or stroll the Inner Harbour's illuminated waterfront.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: One of the most activity-packed ships sailing from Seattle: North Star observation capsule, RipCord by iFLY skydiving, FlowRider, and Broadway-style shows — a strong fit for families and active travelers who want plenty to do on sea days.
